title: Look at a CD under the desklamp: C loops, E wins after a slow start
goal: look at cd under the desklamp.
task_kind: look at object under a lamp
shows: C alternates `go to desk 1` / `go to shelf 1` for 20+ steps. E does the same for 4 steps, then goes to desk 2, finds the lamp, takes the CD and wins at step 17 despite 4 invalid `move` commands.
why_interesting: Shows E is not clean: it also stalls, but the rule "find the light source first, then move the object under it" breaks the loop.
